factors.name: slope

factors.name: stoniness

factors.name: water_holding

factors.name: salinity

factors.name: sodicity

factors.name: gypsum

factors.name: carbonate

factors.name: soil_reaction

factors.name: fertility

factors.name: drainage

factors.name: water_supply

factors.name: temperature
